snippet.title: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault | Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
💚Pre-order #Moonlighter 2 now: https://re.11bits.com/6w4
⚔️Try out the Demo: https://re.11bits.com/6w4
🧹Claim #Moonlighter for free on Steam: https://re.11bits.com/k2e

Will's shop is finally open for business - for real this time!

Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault launches in full version on September 2nd.

The 1.0 release concludes Will's story in Tresna, introducing new weapons and armor, a Bomb Path, and a Hardcore mode for those willing to risk it all. And for the merchants who can't get enough, the Infinite Endless Vault awaits.
